messages:
Priya S: Heads-up — bringing up Sable-22B-lite for perf + quant experiments. Need to prioritize latency-sensitive routes and quick regress checks.
Mateo R: +1. What are the target slices? real-time chat vs async embed gen?
Priya S: Primary: chat (reqs < 300ms p50 target, p95 < 700ms). Secondary: batch embedding fallback (throughput).
Alice C: For quant, do we plan int8 static or dynamic? I vote starting with dynamic int8 (faster path to failure modes).
Priya S: Agreed. Start with dynamic int8. If quality looks off then try awq/int4 knobs.
Tom B: Availability: I can carve a 2h slot tomorrow 10–12PT for microbench and ctx-sweep. Who owns warmup scripts?
Nina K: I can handle warmup — will run prefix warmup + KV cache fills. Also add a coldstart trace.
Jenna QA: Request: add eval prompts for dialog safety QA and hallucination spot checks in the same run so we catch regressions early.
Priya S: Good call. Add these checks to the bench pipeline. Minimal checklist:
```
- baseline perf (fp16) on 1xA100
- dynamic-int8 smoke (same infra)
- ctx length sweep: 512,1024,2048,4096
- batching profiles: 1..8 concurrency, batching off/on
- warmup vs coldstart latency
- sample evals (QA + LLM-quality prompts)
- save perf traces + token-level timing
```
Mateo R: Bench command I'm going to run:
```
./bench_runner --model sable-22b-lite --mode throughput --quant dynamic-int8 --ctx 2048 --bs 1..8 --out ./artifacts/sable22b_dynint8
```
Mateo R: Plan to capture `perf.json` and kernel logs. Will tag runs with `sable22b-intake-2026-03-20`
Priya S: Can bench-bot auto-upload artifacts to the shared bucket?
bench-bot: Upload complete — artifacts available at: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal-bench/sable22b-intake-2026-03-20/ (permissions: eng-ml only) :white_check_mark:
Tom B: If p95 exceeds 900ms on chat after int8, we should add kv-cache warmup and try batching=off for latency-critical routes.
Nina K: I'll run a quick kv-cache-only warmup script and post traces.
Priya S: Prioritization: 1) chat latency (critical), 2) quality smoke, 3) throughput/embeds. If chat fails, we block rollout to hosted until fallback policy is ready.
Alice C: For model gate, set a quality delta threshold: samples BLEU-like or more practical — use our eval harness and require < 3% drop on our convo-quality metric.
Jenna QA: I'll add those checks to the eval harness and mark flaky prompts.
infra-bot: Reserved GPU pool `eng-ml-staging-2` for 2h starting 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z. Job id: res-87219.
Priya S: Thanks. Owners: Mateo (bench runs + artifacts), Nina (warmup + traces), Jenna (evals), Alice (quant tuning). I'll track in the intake board.
Mateo R: Starting first pass in ~5m, posting quick numbers in this thread.
bench-bot: microbench finished: p50=210ms p95=620ms (fp16 baseline) — artifacts linked above.
Mateo R: dyn-int8 smoke done: p50=230ms p95=780ms, quality check: minor tokenization mismatch on emojis, overall conv-quality drop ~1.8% (within threshold).
Priya S: Nice. Nina, can you post coldstart numbers?
Nina K: Coldstart trace: p50=380ms p95=1100ms, kv-cache warmup reduces p95 to 650ms after 2 requests. Will add the trace file.
Priya S: OK — action items: (1) Alice try AWQ/int4 sanity run after lunch; (2) Jenna validate eval set; (3) Mateo smoke-run hosted fallback routing config; (4) Nina finalize warmup script and KV heuristics. I'll update intake ticket and mark priority=high.
Tom B: Thanks team. Short thread for the rollup: post final numbers and I'll kick off canary once quality gates pass. :rocket:
